Contract Generator.contract:
Contract ManageUserCRUDService::createUser(userid: String,name: String,sex: Sex[M|F],password: String,email: String,faculty: String,loanednumber: Integer,borrowstatus: BorrowStatus[NORMAL|SUSPEND],suspensiondays: Integer,overduefee: Real): Boolean {
	definition:
		obs: User = User.allInstance()->any(o|o.UserID = userid),
		isValidSex: Boolean = sex.oclIsTypeOf(Sex),
		isValidBorrowStatus: Boolean = borrowstatus.oclIsTypeOf(BorrowStatus),
		isValidUser: Boolean = obs.oclIsUndefined() and
		isValidSex and
		isValidBorrowStatus
	precondition:
		Admin.oclIsUndefined() = bool
	postcondition:
		let newUser: User in
		newUser.oclIsNew() and
		User.allInstance()->includes(newUser) and
		newUser.UserID = userid and
		newUser.Name = name and
		newUser.Sex = sex and
		newUser.Password = password and
		newUser.Email = email and
		newUser.Faculty = faculty and
		newUser.LoanedNumber = loanednumber and
		newUser.BorrowStatus = borrowstatus and
		newUser.SuspensionDays = suspensiondays and
		newUser.OverDueFee = overduefee and
		result = true
}
